notes.title: V1.1.1 版本更新 Update
notes.notes:
1、增加了星图（现在只要探索过的行星就可以通过星图进行快速传送）

2、增加与优化各个星球的显示（现在靠近行星都会出现星球介绍及名称）

3、新增传送后快速存档功能（现在通过星图每传送到一颗行星都会进行快速存档）

4、增加星球探索时飞行器位置图标（现在采矿时再也不怕找不到自己的飞行器了）

5、修改虫星刷新机制并增加存档功能（现在到达虫星只要按E键就可以进行菜单选择存档、探索、入侵（入侵玩法目前正在制作当中暂未开放）


1. Added star maps (now any planets that have been explored can be quickly transmitted through star maps)

2. Increase and optimize the display of various planets (now planet introductions and names will appear when approaching planets)

3. New fast save function after transmission (now every planet transmitted through the star map will be quickly saved)

4. Add the position icon of the aircraft during planet exploration (now mining is no longer afraid of not finding your own aircraft)

5. Modify the Worm Star refresh mechanism and add the archive function (now when you reach Worm Star, just press the E key to select the menu for save, explore, and invade (the invasion gameplay is currently under production and is not yet open)

物资简介：
矿石：可通过初始新手关卡《月球漫步》或去水星采集获得
能量：可从开局月球或水星采集获得、能量可通过矿石提炼或空战战利品获得
食物：可通过击败虫星怪物获得

Material Introduction:
Mineral: can be obtained through the initial beginner level "Moonwalk" or by collecting from Mercury
Energy: can be collected from the Moon or Mercury at the beginning, and can be obtained through ore extraction or air combat spoils
Food: can be obtained by defeating Worm Star monsters

通告：为提升游戏品质与减速更新频率（玩家反馈每次打开游戏都会有更新感到不适），现从周更改为每月一次更新，每次更新将完善游戏玩法）
Notice: In order to improve the quality of the game and slow down the update frequency (players have reported discomfort with updates every time they open the game), it is now changed from weekly to monthly updates, which will improve the gameplay

notes.notes:
1、新增可进入星球：月球 （现在可以在月球上采集矿石）

2、新增可探索星际据点：联盟号（在太阳附近）

3、修复开始游戏后重开游戏时无法移动与操作的问题

4、优化存档相关功能（数据丢失问题已修复）


1. New accessible planet: Moon (now able to collect minerals on the Moon)

2. Newly added exploratory interstellar stronghold: Soyuz (near the Sun)

3. Fix the issue of being unable to move and operate when restarting the game after starting the game

4. Optimize archiving related functions
